channel.title: Notes from the bench
channel.description: Notes from the bench: what I measured, what broke and what I would do differently.

item.title: 5,800 to 53,000 req/s by skipping the filter chain
item.description: I made a Spring endpoint nine times faster this week. The way I did it is by skipping most of what Spring does to keep you safe.

item.title: 661 backups and none of them off-site
item.description: At work I would never accept a system without a tested, off-site backup. At home I ran one for years, and it held everything I actually care about.

item.title: A gateway that logs every body
item.description: 'We sent it correctly.' I have heard that sentence many times, and most of the time I could not check it.

item.title: A gateway that remembers every request
item.description: Recording every request body costs my new gateway about a third of its throughput. I think that is cheap.

item.title: A K2 firmware update deletes your config and your root
item.description: I rooted my printer, changed its config, and then got annoyed when a firmware update did not respect my changes.

item.title: A Kafka-like queue on MySQL
item.description: Everybody knows you should not build a message queue on a database. I just did, and I think it was the right call.

item.title: A map tile as a 64-bit integer
item.description: I want to know where users are, and I do not want to know where users are.

item.title: A screen saver for a Chromecast, to save a plasma TV
item.description: I have a plasma TV and a Chromecast, and they do not like each other.

item.title: A stopwatch you can leave on in production
item.description: I like profilers. I also cannot use one where I need it most, which is in production, on the request that is slow right now.

item.title: A study buddy that refuses to give the answer
item.description: We built it in about an hour. Agreeing on what to build took most of the day.

item.title: Back to the world
item.description: I thought that since it feels pretty late to enter the blogosphere at my age, I will write up a small explanation, if there is anyone interested.

item.title: Balanced ventilation in a house from 2000, with no visible ducts
item.description: I spent a month putting balanced ventilation into our house, and I made the job about twice as big as it needed to be. On purpose.

item.title: 44 watts for 200 m³/h: balancing the ventilation myself
item.description: The extra ducts paid off. Balancing the ventilation was simple.

item.title: eclipselink-maven-plugin 2.6.2 released
item.description: I’m happy to announce version 2.6.2 of eclipselink-maven-plugin!

item.title: Five bugs in my own gateway in one day
item.description: On 18 September I filed five bugs against my own gateway. I had not found any of them myself. An AI review did, in code I have run since 2023.

item.title: Generic API documenter for web-services
item.description: For some time I have meant to fully document all the different APIs I’m involved in. It gives a more professional feel, it helps integrators and front-end developers and it actually makes it…

item.title: Geo lookups without a database
item.description: In May I imported the world into MySQL. In October I deleted the database, and the library got simpler.

item.title: NVIDIA GTX 970 overclocking
item.description: This page was created to try to distill the information from more than 5,000 forum posts.

item.title: Parsing ISO-8601 21 to 67 times faster than java.time
item.description: In September 2026 I spent three days making a date parser faster. It already took less than a microsecond.

item.title: JSON Schema to XSD
item.description: Everyone is moving from XML to JSON. I just wrote a tool that goes the other way.
